verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes clean visual editing as an acceptance condition for the trial clips while excluding the administrative deadline from the Event.
The client concretely requires polished, straightforward editing and avoidance of distracting effects and transitions; overwriting editing_style leaves no stale attribute.
The client strengthens the visual-editing rule to clean, simple editing with no animations, flashy transitions, or other distracting effects; existing keys are overwritten without requiring removals.
First concrete failure: review of the submitted clips identified distracting effects and transitions that violated the clean visual-editing requirement.
